_: Scenes for the door walkthrough (door.html). Rects are PERCENTAGES of the scene image: {x, y} top-left, w/h size as a percent of the whole image. Tune them by eye with door.html?debug=1 (outlines every hotspot + its label). Scene images are 1920x1080 webp; portrait variants (900x1600) are auto-detected as the same filename plus -portrait, e.g. hall-portrait.webp. Missing images render as PLACEHOLDER blocks.
